BinaryBody.description: Marker: the HTTP body is raw bytes, not JSON (headers carry the metadata)

Cursor.description: Opaque base64url cursor of the last sort key (05 §1.5)

Domain.description: Lowercase ASCII host or registrable domain (IDN in punycode)

Fingerprint.description: Posting fingerprint: fp1: + SHA-256 hex of the src|/gen| key (03 §4.2)

Revision.description: Row revision (D-21); starts at 1 and increments on every update
